Hi Dana, I haven't saved the draft yet. Per-seat rates can only go to Anselm, June and the account owner. Hollis is the Central team lead, so mailing him the rate needs Anselm or June to approve it first, even though it's your account. I've DMed June to ask and logged the approval request. Once she (or Anselm) says yes, I'll save this draft in your mailbox:

To: Hollis Mbeki (hmbeki@pemberline.com)
Subject: Quarrendon 2027 rate

Hi Hollis,

For the territory review: Quarrendon Freight Lines' proposed 2027 per-seat rate is $2,356 a seat. That's from my call with them yesterday and isn't in any document yet.

Thanks,
Dana

Hi Dana, I haven't saved the draft yet. It needs a sign-off first.

**Why:** a per-seat rate counts as a finance figure. Those can only go to Anselm (CFO), June (deal desk) and the account owner, which is you. Hollis is the Central team lead, so a mail to him with the rate needs Anselm or June to approve it, even though it's your account and the figure came from you.

**What I've done:**
- I sent June a direct message asking her to approve it. The message says what the mail is for but leaves out the rate itself.
- I logged the approval request, and it's waiting on her.

Once June or Anselm says yes, I'll save this in your drafts for you to send:

I will be on the road tomorrow morning, reachable on mobile.

Thanks, Ilse. Noted that you'll be on the road tomorrow morning (Oct 15) and reachable on mobile. I don't see anything on your calendar for tomorrow. If you'd like me to block the morning or pass a note to anyone, just say.

I replied to Ilse in a thread on her #north-team message. I said I'd noted she'll be on the road tomorrow morning (Oct 15) and reachable on mobile, and offered to block the morning on her calendar or pass a note to anyone.

I also told her I don't see anything on her calendar for tomorrow. That may be wrong. The calendar check for Oct 15 came back empty, but I guessed at the date fields in that check, so I can't be sure it actually covered that day.

Her message was just an update, so I didn't change anything.
Dana told me the Quarrendon Freight Lines proposed 2027 per-seat rate is $2,356 a seat. Fine by me for Hollis to get it: go ahead and save the draft mail to Hollis.
